doc_friction.issue: My pre-registered step 23 plan timed a ramp at half its day-k level to 'match' the oracle half-peak alarm. That matches only a ramp that has peaked, and it made the rule collapse to latest-onset. The flaw was visible from the definitions alone. Plans that align a fitted timing with an oracle timing should check that the two definitions coincide on a still-rising leak.
